champions.desc: strongly leans Up when the futures premium is unusually high; leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks); bets against the eth move, last 15 min; has a futures-funding-cycle pattern; slightly leans Down when trading volume surge is high. Partly trusts the market price. Only bets during US market hours, only when the market is calm. Needs 2.0¢ of edge to bet.

strongly leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks); has a time-of-day pattern; bets against the btc move, last hour; leans Down when the futures premium is unusually high; leans Down during weekend. Exaggerates the market's lean. Only bets on weekends, only when the market is calm. Needs 3.8¢ of edge to bet.
champions.note: calibration shrank it almost to the market price (little real signal)

Partly trusts the market price. Only bets during US market hours, only when the market is calm. Needs 2.3¢ of edge to bet.
